name: Yuedeng Huiye
source:
Another existence that self-proclaims to be Lumina, apparently wishing Fancia and others to live peacefully here.

[spoiler]This Lumina is half of the real Lumina Fullmoon's soul in the Dreamland. She wants to indulge in the hapinness of the eternal Dreamland, antagonizing her other half and effectively keeping the real Lumina trapped in the dream.[/spoiler]
